overview: A store hiring and training roster for Roadie Roster, now readable by your own AI assistant through the Internet Computer MCP connector.
features: Read roadies, positions, pending sign-ups, orientation sessions and attendance, opening questions, crew events and answers, trainer notes and alerts from your own AI assistant
Access follows each person's real, current role, with Trainers limited to their own stations and crew leaders to their own crew
Contact details, photos, signatures and birth dates are never shared
Demo data stays separate from real data
